dynamicelytra.configuration.title: %s
dynamicelytra.config.trails.tooltip: Jet-style contrail ribbons off your elytra wingtips.
dynamicelytra.config.lifetime.tooltip: How long each point lingers before it fades out.
dynamicelytra.config.width.tooltip: Base thickness of the ribbon, as a percentage of a block.
dynamicelytra.config.tip_lines.tooltip: Draw a thin crisp contrail line on each wingtip edge, like a plane, over the rough vapor wash.
dynamicelytra.config.airspeed.tooltip: Speed below which no trail forms.
dynamicelytra.config.turn_response.toolt: How much a hard bank thickens and brightens the ribbon.
dynamicelytra.config.saturation.tooltip: Colour intensity. 0 is pure white vapor.
dynamicelytra.config.show_others.tooltip: Draw trails for other players and mobs, not just you.
dynamicelytra.config.first_person.toolti: Draw your own trail in first person. It fades near the camera so it streams away behind you instead of covering the view.
dynamicelytra.config.fall_trails.tooltip: Emit a thin stream on a fast non-elytra free fall.
dynamicelytra.config.riptide_trails.tool: Emit a burst on a riptide trident launch.
dynamicelytra.config.speedlines.tooltip: First-person streaks that bloom the faster you move.
dynamicelytra.config.sl_enabled.tooltip: Master switch for the first-person speed-lines overlay.
dynamicelytra.config.sl_style.tooltip: Lines = crisp tapered streaks, Smear = softer denser wedges, Vignette = the screen edges rush and darken.
dynamicelytra.config.sl_threshold.toolti: Speed at which the effect begins.
dynamicelytra.config.sl_length.tooltip: How far the streaks reach toward the edges.
dynamicelytra.config.sl_focus.tooltip: How far the point the streaks radiate from shifts toward the bottom of the screen.
dynamicelytra.config.sl_sprint.tooltip: Effect strength while sprinting. 0 disables it.
dynamicelytra.config.sl_fall.tooltip: Effect strength while falling fast. 0 disables it.
dynamicelytra.config.sl_vehicle.tooltip: Effect strength in boats, minecarts and on horses. 0 disables it.
dynamicelytra.config.sl_riptide.tooltip: Effect strength on a riptide trident launch. 0 disables it.
dynamicelytra.config.sl_elytra.tooltip: Effect strength while gliding. 0 disables it.
